notes: Fixed a major gap in Entry Rejections: the outer time-window, data-freshness, and sector-filter checks in evaluateEntry() were silently blocking symbols without logging anything, so strategies with a closed time window or an active sector filter showed zero rejections. Now logged as GUARD_TIME_WINDOW, GUARD_DATA_STALE, GUARD_SECTOR_STALE, and GUARD_SECTOR_STRENGTH.
